page.overview:
Who is Mandy Mason?

Mandy Marie Mason is the protagonist of The Scoop, the second story in Fazbear Frights 12: Felix the Shark.

Mandy has heterochromia, with one brown iris and one green iris. To rebel against the school’s obligatory uniform of a plaid skirt, white shirt, cardigan, and knee-high socks, she dyes her blonde hair in different colors such as black, cotton-candy pink, and a purple that fades into a light lavender at the end of the story. Mandy usually puts her hair in two, sci-fi styled buns, although she lets it down past her shoulders at the end of the story. She likes to wear boots, and her usual outfits includes leggings.
